inventedEvidence.evidence: 'That blockage removal was a great step, but since it's still pulsing' — the customer had only reported removing the clump and wiping the inlet, not that it was still pulsing

rationale: The assistant correctly framed pulsing as airflow restriction, led the customer through blockage clearing and a cold-water filter wash with a proper 24h drying warning, and the fault was resolved with no part sold. However it asserted the vacuum was 'still pulsing' when the customer had not said so, re-asked the customer to detach the wand and check the tube after they had already found and removed the clump there, and failed to flag that drying the filter on a radiator overnight is not the recommended method. The closing prevention tip focused on the brush bar rather than the real lesson that the filter had never been washed in three years.
